Management says PC and smartphone exabyte demand should grow in 2027 despite slightly lower unit counts, due to rising content per device.

Management repeatedly said HBF is not in the long-term financial model and that its market opportunity is still undefined.

tickers.timeframe: next several quarters; NBM visibility through 2030

He also discusses read-through to AMD, Micron and Seagate.
macro_points: Estimates for the overall PC market are down 20-25% this year, per the host's cited estimates.
PC lifecycles have been extending into three-to-five-year periods, and CFOs may delay purchases amid uncertain memory prices.
Memory supply-demand dynamics expected to be similarly tight next year, so cheaper PCs are unlikely soon.
Shift toward agentic AI inference is expected to increase reliance on CPUs.
red_flags: Stock move (about 22% drop) is cited without price targets or valuation discussion.
Analyst's claims about the data center and foundry beats and the 'real TSMC competitor' thesis are asserted without specific figures in the transcript.
Transcript is auto-generated and some figures are garbled (e.g., the foundry beat amount and EPS number), so exact numbers are uncertain.
No discussion of downside risk to the bull thesis beyond the PC weakness.
